name: scene3d_add_shots
description: Add Motion takes. One take is a self-contained event/action timeline; use an internal cut for camera coverage changes. Take boundaries are hard cuts. @see guides_get('scene3d')

shots.description: In order. Max 24 in the sequence.

afterShotId.description: Insert after this take instead of at the end. Ignored with duplicateOf — a copy lands after its source.

duplicateOf.description: Copy this take (keyframes included) instead of creating an empty one.

name.description: Take label, e.g. "Wide establishing". Omit to leave the timeline's positional label.
